keyFindings.description: The stub's 2 s self-end plus the < 3000 ms bound let the test pass when queryTmux's kill never arrives. The workaround is for Bun 1.3.14 (the pod's bun: 7 of 12 timed-out execFileSync calls waited the child's full 5 s with no signal); at the pinned Bun 1.4.4 (.bun-version, CI) 12 of 12 were killed at about 1 s. Restore a bound that fails a missing kill (elapsed < 2000, or drop the self-end) and run it on the pinned Bun.

The test pre-reads the issue to avoid a product layout shift: the unread mark's own row (ConversationTab.tsx:621-624, :1212-1216) disappears when the read mark answers and moves the cards up under the pointer. Fix the shift at its source with a browser test that fails before, then drop the pre-read; or send the scope decision to the architect. 'Not changed' in the PR body is no outcome.

The PR makes Deps.Lifetime required (register panics without it) at the api package boundary and carries no '## Contract change census' (search commands, every hit with its disposition, rollout line).

due := time.Now() comes after time.NewTicker(interval), so the first two due times are less than one period apart and can share a bucket: the second sweep is refused and a lone sweeper loses that period. Take due before NewTicker.

beforeNextBoundary aims at a boundary on the database's clock while Exclusive now buckets on the process's clock, so with a database clock offset the two boundary tests no longer place a tick near the boundary the code uses and stop catching a regression. exclusive_latency_test.go:33-36 and exclusive.go:55-59, :86-88 describe a measure the code no longer makes.

No changelog fragments: packages/envoy (leased loops lose no period; event stream reset read), packages/claude-envoy (one heartbeat at startup) and packages/pi-legion (the bundled merge-gate skill's re-run) change behaviour, and AGENTS.md asks for a fragment per package.
